title: City Council District 9
statement: Uptown's commercial distress metrics don't tell the full story—we're investing in long-term stability, not quick fixes. That 10/10 momentum didn't come from chasing trends—it came from methodical community investment. I stand by our district's measured approach.

payload.text: Our small-business stabilization targets systemic vulnerabilities, not just today's sentiment dips. The numbers will catch up to the groundwork we're laying now.
